record.oneLiner: A spike-crested hadrosaur known from two continents.
record.description: Saurolophus was a large duck-billed hadrosaur of the Late Cretaceous, distinguished by a spike-like crest projecting up and back from its skull. Unusually, it is known from both North America and Asia.

notableFacts.text: Bore a solid spike-like crest projecting up and back from the skull.
One of the few dinosaur genera known from two continents.
